name: Curse of Entropy
body:
Everything falls to ruin.

Bonus Spells: 0th—touch of fatigue, 1st—break, 2nd—diminish resistance, 3rd—rusting grasp, 4th—rune of ruin

Curse Manifestation

The lathspell exudes an aura of degradation and collapse. Within 10 feet of the lathspell, all firearms have their misfire chance increased by 1. On a critical fumble (natural 1) on an attack roll made within 10 feet of the lathspell, the attacker must make a Reflex save equal to the Lathspell’s curse DC or the weapon they are using gains the broken condition for 1 minute.

Additionally, if a creature is subject to a critical hit within 10 feet of the lathspell, they must make a Reflex save or their armor receives the broken condition. If the subject creature is using a natural weapon, spell, or special ability, they instead gain -2 to attack rolls for 1 minute. For affected creatures without armor who would be subject to the broken armor, they instead suffer a -2 AC to a maximum of their natural armor or deflection bonus.

Curse Abilities
Bolt of Entropy (Sp)

You point your finger and unleash the fell power of your entropy curse at your target as a standard action. You make a ranged touch attack with a range of 30 feet. If the attack hits, the target takes 1d8 points of damage +1 for every two lathspell levels you possess. If the target has hardness or DR, the bolt instead reduces the hardness or DR by the damage dealt for 1 minute instead of dealing damage. Any damage over the hardness or DR remaining is dealt to the target’s hp. You must wait 1 minute between uses of this ability or until you successfully break or destroy an object with a sunder combat maneuver or spell.

Call of Time (Su)

You utter an entropic curse as a standard action at a target within 30 feet, and they feel the weight of time upon them. They must make a Will save or become fatigued. If the target is already fatigued, they instead become exhausted, though they gain a +5 bonus on their saving throw against progressing to exhausted. Once a creature has been targeted by this curse, they are immune to it for 24 hours.

Disintegrate (Sp)

Prerequisite(s) 10th level or higher

You gain the spell disintegrate as a spell-like ability usable once per day. You may deliver this spell as part of your cursed strike ability. You gain an additional use at 18th level.

Entropic Explosion (Sp)

Prerequisite(s) 10th level or higher

You can draw in the power of your curse and release it in an explosion of dark energy. All creatures within a 10-foot radius of you must make a Reflex save or take 1d6 damage per lathspell level and be slowed for 1d4 rounds. On a successful save, the creature is not slowed and the damage is halved.

In either case, if the target has hardness or DR, that protection is reduced by the damage dealt before damage is dealt to the creature’s hp. This reduction in hardness or DR lasts for 1 minute. You must wait 1 minute between uses of this ability and during that time, your curse manifestation is suppressed and you are unable to use bolt of entropy or weapon of entropy.

Mark of Ruin (Su)

You point out a target and curse them with the mark of ruin as a swift action. For the remainder of combat, their DR, hardness, and AC derived from armor or natural armor are reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0). This also reduces the hardness of all carried objects by the same amount. The reduction increases to 2 at 5th level and by an additional 1 for every 5 levels thereafter. Once a creature has been targeted by this curse, they are immune to it for 24 hours.

Ruinous Strike (Su)

Your entropic curse infuses your weapon. You gain Improved Sunder as a bonus feat. When performing a sunder combat maneuver, you deal double damage to any object and any hardness the object has is reduced by half for 1 minute after the hit. This hardness reduction only impacts one 5 foot cube of object. This hardness reduction does not compound or stack. At 8th level, you gain Greater Sunder as a bonus feat.

Additionally, you are able to perform a cursed strike with this sunder attempt if the combat maneuver roll is a natural 20.

Spell Entropy (Sp)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

You can, as one of your attacks during the round, use your entropic curse to dispel a spell with your weapon strike. You make a sunder combat maneuver against the target. If the result exceeds 11 + the caster level of the spell, the spell is dispelled.

If the result exceeds the target amount by enough to exceed 11 + the caster level of another spell on the target, that spell is also dispelled. You must wait 1 minute between uses of this ability or until you successfully break or destroy an object with a sunder combat maneuver or spell.

Touch of Aging (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

You can, as one of your attacks during a round, impart an aspect of your entropy curse as a touch attack that causes the target to age and degrade. They advance one age category and take the penalties to Strength, Constitution, and Dexterity but do not gain the wisdom of those passing years. They do not gain bonuses to Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. This aging lasts for 1 minute per level and is ineffective against ageless or immortal creatures.

If used on an object, construct, or undead, this ability instead deals 1d6 damage per 2 class levels you possess. The target is allowed a Fortitude save to halve this damage.

You must wait 1 minute between uses of this ability, during this time, your entropy curse manifestation is suppressed and you are unable to use call of time.

Weapon of Entropy (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

You instill into your weapon the degrading energy of your curse. This ability is triggered as a swift action made during or before an attack sequence.

The next successful hit made within a round deals an additional 1d8 points of damage +1 for every two lathspell levels you possess. If the target has hardness or DR, the weapon instead reduces the hardness or DR by the damage dealt for 1 minute instead of dealing damage. Any damage over the hardness or DR remaining is dealt to the target’s hp. You must wait 1 minute between uses of this ability or until you successfully break or destroy an object with a sunder combat maneuver or spell.

Word of Ruin (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

You utter a cursed word as a standard action that causes a weapon or object you designate to fall to ruin.

You may, up to a range of 30 feet, perform a sunder combat maneuver using your Charisma in place of your Strength. The damage dealt is 1d6 plus your Charisma modifier. Any feats or abilities that affect sunder combat maneuvers apply to this special combat maneuver.

Walking Curse
Scion of Entropy (Su)

You are a true agent of entropy; you have seen the end of all things and your curse will hasten it. You no longer need to wait between uses of weapon of entropy, bolt of entropy, spell entropy, or touch of time.

Additionally you gain the use of the spell energy drain as a spell-like ability usable once per day, and you may deliver it as part of your cursed strike ability.
